comments.author: carol
comments.body: Handler opening a session directly: isn't that exactly what ADR-003 says not to do? Should this be a `health` service?

comments.author: bob
comments.body: I went back and forth. A service that just runs SELECT 1 felt like ceremony.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Health and metrics endpoints are the one place where touching infrastructure directly is the point: they exist to check the DB/Redis connection itself. I've added that exception to ADR-003 in this PR so we don't have this discussion every time. Business endpoints still go through services.

threads.rejection_reason: Operational endpoints (health/metrics) are an explicit exception to ADR-003.
